title: Directional derivatives of C^2 global weak solutions of constant-coefficient systems are global weak solutions
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm, and A a continuous bilinear form on L. Let V : R^n -> R^l be C^2 and assume that the integral over R^n of A[DV(x)][Dzeta(x)] is 0 for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l. Let v in R^n and d_vV(x) := DV(x)v. Then the integral over R^n of A[D(d_vV)(x)][Dzeta(x)] is 0 for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (V : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (v : Rn n), ContDiff ℝ 2 V → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ V x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ V y v) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0
